outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Hamburger SV 0.72 vs FC Bayern München 2.80, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Hamburger SV at home: 3W-0D-1L, 6 scored and 7 conceded in 4 games.
FC Bayern München away: 3W-2D-0L, 9 scored and 5 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 2.07 goals per game, away teams 1.32.
Recent league form (newest first): Hamburger SV LWLLW, FC Bayern München DWDWW (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: Hamburger SV has 4 home games and FC Bayern München 5 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
